rows.title: Integrated Filing- Financial
rows.summary: Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 33 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today i.e., Wednesday, 12th August 2026, has inter-alia considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter ended on June 30, 2026 along with the Limited Review Report. ln view of above, please find enclosed herewith a copy of the Integrated Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 along with the Limited Review Report.The aforesaid results are also being made available on the website of the Company i.e. www.irctc.com
